name: VMware Monitor
description: Read-only VMware vCenter and ESXi monitoring with 33 MCP tools for inventory, alarms, events, health triage, and object investigation. All exposed tools are read-only; it has no infrastructure mutation tools. Runs locally over stdio; customers retain private connectivity and credentials for their own vCenter. Requires Python 3.10+ and uv/uvx. Configure the server following the linked repository README before use.

install.notes: Configure local targets and credentials using the repository README. vCenter must be reachable from the machine running Cline. This installation launches the published 2.6.1 package locally, not a hosted VMware service.
